# odigos-central_source (Resource)

Enables or disables Odigos instrumentation for a Kubernetes workload (Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, and so on) on one data stream. Set `selected` to false to disable without destroying the resource. Destroying the resource removes it from `current_stream_name` only; other streams in `data_stream_names` (for example membership added outside this resource) are left unchanged. Changing `cluster_name`, `name`, `kind`, or `namespace` forces replacement. Changing `current_stream_name` moves the source between streams. Odigos allows one source per workload: a second resource for the same Deployment (or other kind) on another stream is rejected. Change `current_stream_name` on the existing resource to move it. Creating or destroying several resources for the same workload runs one at a time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odigos-central_source" "example" {
  cluster_name        = "my-cluster"
  name                = "my-deployment"
  kind                = "Deployment"
  namespace           = "my-namespace"
  current_stream_name = "default"
  selected            = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the cluster
- `current_stream_name` (String) The name of the data stream to use when persisting source selection.
- `kind` (String) The type of the source
- `name` (String) The name of the source
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the source

### Optional

- `selected` (Boolean) Whether the source is selected for instrumentation. Set to false to disable. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) The id of the cluster
- `conditions` (Attributes List) The conditions of the source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `containers` (Attributes List) The containers of the source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--containers))
- `data_stream_names` (List of String) The names of the data streams
- `otel_service_name` (String) The name of the otel service

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Read-Only:

- `last_transition_time` (String) The last transition time of the condition
- `message` (String) The message of the condition
- `reason` (String) The reason of the condition
- `status` (String) The status of the condition
- `type` (String) The type of the condition


<a id="nestedatt--containers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `containers`

Read-Only:

- `container_name` (String) The name of the container
- `instrumentation_message` (String) The instrumentation message of the container
- `instrumented` (Boolean) Whether the container is instrumented
- `language` (String) The language of the container
- `otel_distro_name` (String) The otel distro name of the container
- `overridden` (Boolean) Whether the container is overridden
- `runtime_version` (String) The runtime version of the container

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import odigos-central_source.example my-cluster/my-namespace/Deployment/my-deployment/default
```
